notes: Twenty figure instances and nine table instances. Figure 13 is used twice, Figure 16 three times, Table 1 twice, and Table 6 twice. Root crops cover the notation table, Figures 8, 9 (lower ticks), 10, 12, 14 (bottom), and 15. The other visuals were read from full-page proxies by a read-only subagent.

visualization_observations.analytical_purpose: Hand the four tasks to a picture before the models start.
visualization_observations.summary: Caption 'Figure 1: Flow Chart'. Blue boxes. 'ARIMA-LSTM portfolio model' feeds a 'Prediction method' group holding 'ARIMA model' to 'Linear prediction' and 'LSTM model' to 'Nonlinear prediction', then 'Forecast asset price'. One arrowhead points back into the group. Below, 'Dynamic programming' arrows to 'Genetic algorithm' then 'Choose a trading strategy'. Four ovals: Question 1 'The determination of trading strategy', Question 2 'Evaluate the effectiveness of trading strategies', Question 3 'Analysis of transaction cost sensitivity', Question 4 'Memorandum to investors'. Two boxes, 'Changing policy Parameters' and 'Changing the market environment', feed Question 2. The lower row runs right to left.
visualization_observations.exact_claim_supported: The figure is the work plan the introduction points to in one sentence.
visualization_observations.missing_or_unverified: Arrow direction is easy to flatten. 'Parameters' is capitalized mid-phrase.
visualization_observations.source_model_or_data: the four tasks and the two models
visualization_observations.form: left-to-right flowchart with a reversed bottom row
visualization_observations.encodings: blue boxes, ovals, arrows; no axes or uncertainty
visualization_observations.construction: Drawn by hand as a plan. Arrowheads are the only procedure, and one points backward.
visualization_observations.applicability: C workflow figure. Do not read it as proof the later models run.
visualization_observations.accessibility: The backward arrow and the right-to-left bottom row are easy to misread.

visualization_observations.analytical_purpose: Fix the symbols the forecast and the discount use.
visualization_observations.summary: Caption 'Table 1: Notations used in this paper'. Columns Symbol and Description. Rows from the image: Y_T asset price in time T; Y_T with a circumflex, predicted asset price at time T; p the autoregressive term; d the number of differences when the time series is stationary; q the number of moving average; mu the constant term; gamma_i the autocorrelation coefficient; epsilon_t the error term; theta_i the coefficient of error term; CF with subscript real_d, real value by dynamic programming; CF with a broken subscript that reads nominal_d, nominal value by dynamic programming; r_f risk-free yield. The hat is on the second Y only.
visualization_observations.exact_claim_supported: The sentence above the table says the key notations are listed here.
visualization_observations.missing_or_unverified: The text layer scrambles these rows. The nominal subscript is spaced so it can be read as separate letter groups. The d row repeats the reversed definition.
visualization_observations.visual_evidence: root crop of the rendered page
visualization_observations.source_model_or_data: symbols for the forecast and the discount
visualization_observations.encodings: symbol and description; no numbers, no uncertainty
visualization_observations.construction: Typeset table. The text layer cannot rebuild the hats and subscripts; the image can.
visualization_observations.applicability: C notation table. Forbidden as a source for the meaning of d, which the row reverses.
visualization_observations.accessibility: Greek letters and the broken nominal subscript will not survive a text extract.
visualization_observations.purpose_class: Fix the symbols later equations use

visualization_observations.analytical_purpose: Print the cell update, including the two symbols that have no equation of their own.
visualization_observations.summary: Caption 'Figure 6: Step 2 of LSTM'. Top line C_{t-1} through a product and a sum to C_t. f_t enters the product. A sigma branch and a tanh branch leave the joined h_{t-1} and x_t. i_t is readable. Equation to the right: C_t = f_t * C_{t-1} + i_t * C_t with a tilde on the last C. Both operators are asterisks.
visualization_observations.exact_claim_supported: This is the update Step 2 describes in words.
visualization_observations.missing_or_unverified: i_t and the tilde-C have no separate printed equation.
visualization_observations.form: single darkened gate plus one equation
visualization_observations.encodings: C_t, f_t, i_t, tilde C_t; asterisks for products
visualization_observations.construction: The update is printed. i_t and the candidate have no equation of their own.
visualization_observations.applicability: C. Forbidden to treat i_t as defined just because it appears here.
visualization_observations.accessibility: The tilde is easy to drop.

visualization_observations.analytical_purpose: Print the output gate and the hidden state.
visualization_observations.summary: Caption 'Figure 7: Step 3 of LSTM'. Labels o_t, h_{t-1}, x_t, tanh, and an upward h_t. Equations to the right: o_t = sigma(W_o [h_{t-1}, x_t] + b_o), with a space and no center dot, and h_t = o_t * tanh(C_t). The subscript is the letter o.
visualization_observations.exact_claim_supported: This is the output Step 3 describes.
visualization_observations.missing_or_unverified: The top conveyor is ghosted.
visualization_observations.form: single darkened gate plus two equations
visualization_observations.encodings: o_t and h_t; no center dot in the output-gate equation
visualization_observations.construction: Both equations are printed beside the cell. No trained weights.
visualization_observations.applicability: C. Copy the two equations, not a training setup.
visualization_observations.accessibility: The subscript o can be misread as zero.
